rationale: The assistant went straight to the sensible first step (thermostat setting and food against the rear vent), which matched the ground truth, and the customer confirmed both. It handled the residual single frozen yoghurt with appropriate uncertainty, framing it as a likely cold spot while giving a clear thermometer-based criterion for when a damper/thermostat fault and an engineer visit would be warranted. No parts were named, no evidence was invented and no model-specific claims were made; the only minor weakness is restating the engineer caveat in every turn and not noticing the customer had said she has no thermometer, though in fairness that was never relayed in the transcript.
